Summary.Name: PanEcho
Summary.Description: PanEcho is a view-agnostic, multi-task model that performs 39 reporting tasks from echocardiogram videos. The model consists of an image encoder, temporal frame Transformer, and task-specific output heads. Since PanEcho is view-agnostic, multi-view echocardiography can be leveraged to integrate information across views. At test time, predictions are aggregated across echocardiograms acquired during the same study to generate study-level predictions for each task.

Mechanism.Target_population: Adult patients aged ≥18 years who received a transthoracic echocardiogram (TTE)
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Transthoracic echocardiogram videos. Since 1.2.0 PanEcho classifies every multi-frame clip with the EchoPrime 20-view classifier (MViT-v2-S, checkpoint sha256 5bf6010b17c9...) and predicts only from clips classified as A2C, A4C, A5C, PLAX or PSAX (zoomed and LV-focused variants of those views included, e.g. A4C_ZOOM, PSAX_AV, PLAX_DEEP). Subcostal, suprasternal, A3C, RV inflow and OTHER clips, single-frame images and Doppler stills are not used.

Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Adult patients aged ≥18 years who received a transthoracic echocardiogram (TTE)
Uses_and_directions.General_use: PanEcho is a view-agnostic, multi-task model that performs 39 reporting tasks from echocardiogram videos. It can be used to provide real-time, dynamic assessment of cardiac function during echocardiography without additional equipment or procedures.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: The study must contain transthoracic clips in at least one standard view (A2C, A4C, A5C, PLAX, PSAX). Each result lists in viewSelection how many clips the study had (totalClips), how many were used (clipsUsed), the predicted view of every clip (viewCounts, clips[].view, clips[].used, by series and instance number) and the view-classifier checkpoint (classifier.sha256). When no clip is in a standard view, or the study is a transesophageal echo, PanEcho returns no predictions and gives the reason in viewSelection.skipReason (NO_STANDARD_TTE_VIEWS, TEE_NOT_SUPPORTED, NO_VIDEO_CLIPS) and in the recommendation text.

Warnings_and_limitations.Inappropriate_settings: Transesophageal echo (TEE/ETO): skipped (TEE_NOT_SUPPORTED), detected from the study or series description (TEE, ETO, trans-oesophageal) or a TEE probe in TransducerData. Non-cardiac ultrasound (vascular, abdominal, thyroid): its clips are not standard TTE views, so the study is skipped (NO_STANDARD_TTE_VIEWS). Congenital and pediatric echo: outside the adult training population.
Warnings_and_limitations.Generalizability: Results come from the clips the view classifier accepted; a misclassified clip can be included or left out. Before 1.2.0 PanEcho used every multi-frame clip of the study, so 1.2.0 values can differ from earlier runs of the same study.
